observations.trace: The current source geometry hash reads branch position/radius fields and leaf position/size/shoot identity, but does not read branch depth or primary/secondary groups or leaf group fields. Those fields participate in current card selection. Holding encoded words fixed while changing a group or depth gives unchanged fingerprint input words with a potentially different selection expression.

existing_finding_connections.classification: Recovered059 crown selection finding newly assessed against95e source; the original finding and source-only reasoning are attributed to Adler, not a new unique discovery.
existing_finding_connections.first_failed_contract: A secondary-limb selection associated with a primary crown sector must preserve that owner through orientation, fitting, provenance counts and raster inputs.
existing_finding_connections.canonical_owner: Owned primary-sector and secondary-limb-run selection, distinct from its encoded u8 mask and inclusive u16 endpoint range.
existing_finding_connections.trace: Current beech generation assigns 20 scaffold primary sectors by azimuth and assigns secondary groups by scaffold_index*8+secondary_index (five groups per scaffold). The LOD1 builder first selects depth-two groups by primary sector, sorts them and records only first..last for each of two runs. The card keeps a primary mask, but its Some(range) branch and leaf predicates ignore that mask. Orientation tests both primary and range; fitting, provenance counts and the raster source filters use the broader card predicate. The typed CommonBeech factory reaches the beech skeleton/leaves and style; the cached-tree path invokes the bake with this style when no prepared asset is supplied.
existing_finding_connections.source_reasoning: The inclusive-unit draw is bounded0..1. Consecutive scaffold phase increments are about1.98..2.82 radians, much larger than a 2π/7 sector and smaller than its circular complement, so adjacent scaffold indices cannot share a sector under the finite source arithmetic. Among20 indices in7 sectors, at least one sector owns at least3 nonadjacent scaffolds. Each has5 ordered IDs; splitting at most two runs forces one run to span IDs from at least2 such scaffolds, so its inclusive endpoints contain an intervening scaffold from another sector. Depth-three twigs and their leaves inherit these IDs, and the range-only predicate admits them. This is an interval and pigeonhole argument from source, not a generated seed or runtime measurement.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: No RNG, tree generator, selected source set, bake, image, GPU output or assertion ran. The numeric source argument assumes the bounded finite draws and normal f32 arithmetic shown; no numerical replay or platform execution was checked. Prepared assets take a separate resolve path, so their contents and actual live availability are not inferred. This establishes a source selection contract question, not measured visual severity or every related alias.

acceptance_requirements: Every secondary run retains its owning primary sector and intended membership through orientation, fitting, provenance and raster input.
Preserve intended supported card topology, atlas budgets and species behavior; no geometry-ID compatibility fallback.
